business_problem: Cogniware, a global investigation platform provider to law enforcement agencies, needed to upgrade their existing system to better serve their clients in addressing these issues. Their existing system required manual effort for tagging and analysis, which wasn't scalable for large volumes of data.
solution_summary: Cogniware leverages AI solutions from IBM to drive efficiency in the financial crime space Cogniware aimed to transform complex data analysis for law enforcement by integrating its Argos platform with IBM watsonx.ai and IBM watsonx.data solutions. This partnership addresses the challenges of unstructured data and user accessibility, enabling fast and accurate investigations-all through advanced AI and data storage capabilities. The watsonx.data solution helped store and manage vast amounts of data, particularly unstructured data. Meanwhile, IBM used watsonx.ai to enhance the platform with tools, such as natural language processing (NLP), machine learning (ML) and generative AI (gen AI).
business_outcome: Improved accessibility: The new capabilities make it easier for nontechnical users to conduct complex data searches without needing a data analyst. Enhanced fraud detection: In the banking sector, the platform can now automatically find unusual transaction patterns that suggest financial crime, leading to quicker action and fewer financial losses.
